text:
carla: deploy-bot just paused the canary promotion for tag=release-2026.03.08. 3/5 staging canaries failed the db-migration-smoke test.

deploy-bot: "promotion paused for tag=release-2026.03.08, reason=integration-tests/db-migration-smoke x3 failures"

devops-oncall: seeing repeated timeouts creating test DB namespaces on runner-17. logs show mkdir conflicts and retries.

alex: snippet from runner logs:
```
ERROR: mkdir /workspace/test-run-912: file exists
Caused by: overlayfs apply diff error during workspace restore
Timeout while applying migration step 001_create_users
```

ben: could be namespace prefix reuse + short migration lock TTL. Any recent CI runner/workspace changes?

sre-monica: no infra deploys in the last 8h. I'm seeing inode errors from overlay apply: `overlay: failed to apply diff: no such file or directory` then immediately `mkdir test-run-912: file exists`. Suggests restore race.

release-mgr: we have a change window closing in ~90 minutes. If this remains, we need to either pin to the previous prod image or extend the window. Impact of pin?

alex: pin to release-2026.03.01 will let prod cut continue. Telemetry changes get delayed. We'd re-run canaries later.

carla: options: (A) manual-promote previous image now; (B) re-run canaries with serialized namespaces and cache-clear flags (slower); (C) extend change window. Which is least risky?

ben: lean manual pin. We can't risk a partial rollout with flaky DB migration. Also open an incident to investigate runner overlayfs failures.

sre-monica: mitigation for re-run: set CI_SERIAL_NAMESPACE=true and RUNNER_CACHE_CLEAR=true to avoid collisions and cache corruption. That will add ~15-25m to the canary run.

deploy-bot: heuristic: recommend pin_previous_image when canary pass rate < 80% or infra-related failures detected.

release-mgr: decision: pin to release-2026.03.01 to meet the change window. Document in release notes and open follow-ups. Schedule serialized rerun at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Who owns the follow-up?

carla: I'll own ENG-3472 and coordinate SRE + infra. ben, please draft the release-note blurb.

ben: draft posted in #release-notes-drafts: "Production cut pinned to 2026.03.01 due to unstable staging DB migrations; follow-up investigation and reroll scheduled (see ENG-3472)."

sre-monica: creating ENG-3472 now, attaching runner logs and overlay diffs. Immediate actions: 1) release-mgr trigger manual promote via deploy-bot, 2) SRE collect full runner diagnostics, 3) devs prepare serialized rerun recipe.

release-mgr: running deploy-bot promote: `promote --image=release-2026.03.01 --reason="staging-db-migration-failure"`

deploy-bot: Promotion queued. Will report status. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devops-oncall: After pin, please set CI_PARALLEL=0 for tomorrow's rerun to reduce chance of parallel collisions.

release-mgr: will set CI_PARALLEL=0 for the scheduled rerun.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Production tag now points to release-2026.03.01. :white_check_mark:

carla: ENG-3472 created and assigned to me. Added logs and next steps. We'll reconvene after the rerun. :spiral_calendar:

alex: opened a tiny runner patch to stop reusing namespace prefixes; will PR and link to ENG-3472.

ben: note to update the release notes post-mortem with final RCA.

sre-monica: adding a monitoring alert for overlay apply failures (trigger if >2 failures in 10m) and scheduling deeper forensics.

carla: summary: manual pin applied to meet change window; ENG-3472 follow-up (owner: carla); rerun planned 09:00 UTC tomorrow with serialized namespaces + cache-clear; SRE investigating runner overlayfs issue. Close thread once ENG-3472 has initial RCA attachment. :lock:
